amourAmiF.q1: Honestly, have you ever imagined making love with her?
amourAmiF.q1a: No, never, the idea makes me uncomfortable
amourAmiF.q1b: Once, and I quickly thought about something else
amourAmiF.q1d: Yes, and it keeps coming back
amourAmiF.q2: Could you see yourself living with her, as a couple, not as roommates?
amourAmiF.q2a: No, we'd drive each other crazy
amourAmiF.q2b: I've never thought about it that way
amourAmiF.q2c: Yes, it doesn't seem that strange to me
amourAmiF.q2d: Yes, and I've already pictured it in detail
amourAmiF.q3: If she kissed you tonight, out of the blue…
amourAmiF.q3a: I'd pull back, or burst out laughing
amourAmiF.q3b: I'd be embarrassed, not knowing what to make of it
amourAmiF.q3d: I've been waiting for that moment for a long time
amourAmiF.q4: When she tells you about someone she likes…
amourAmiF.q4a: I'm happy for her, I want to know everything
amourAmiF.q4b: It doesn't do anything special to me
amourAmiF.q4c: It stings, but I act as if nothing's wrong
amourAmiF.q4d: I change the subject, it makes me sick
amourAmiF.q5: The idea of her getting into a serious relationship…
amourAmiF.q5a: Makes me happy, it's what I wish for her
amourAmiF.q5b: Scares me a little about losing her, like with any friend
amourAmiF.q6: Physical contact with her (a hug, her hand, her head on your shoulder)…
amourAmiF.q6a: It's like with my other friends, nothing more
amourAmiF.q6b: It's nice, with no ulterior motive
amourAmiF.q6c: I look for it a bit, and it always lasts a little too long
amourAmiF.q6d: It does something to me, and I know it
amourAmiF.q7: The people you're attracted to, do you compare them to her?
amourAmiF.q7a: Never, it has nothing to do with it
amourAmiF.q8: When you say "she's my best friend" to introduce her…
amourAmiF.q8a: That's exactly it, the word fits
amourAmiF.q8b: Sometimes the word feels a bit short
amourAmiF.q8c: It stings a little every time
amourAmiF.q9: When you're on a date with someone else…
amourAmiF.q9a: I don't think about her, or only to tell her about it afterwards
amourAmiF.q9b: I sometimes wonder what she would think
amourAmiF.q9c: I think about her more than about the person in front of me
amourAmiF.q9d: I'd rather it were her sitting there
amourAmiF.q10: The "what if…?", have you ever asked yourself while looking at her?
amourAmiF.q10c: Yes, and I think about it again
amourAmiF.q11: Have people ever told you that you'd make a good couple?
amourAmiF.q11a: No, or it just made us both laugh
amourAmiF.q11c: Yes, and it pleased me without my showing it
amourAmiF.q11d: Yes, and I thought about it again that night
amourAmiF.q12: Good news comes in. Who do you text first?
amourAmiF.q12d: Her, and I wait impatiently for the reply
amourAmiF.q13: Before seeing her, do you pay attention to how you look?
amourAmiF.q13a: No, she has seen me in every state
amourAmiF.q13b: A little, like for going out
amourAmiF.q13c: More than with my other friends
amourAmiF.q13d: Yes, and I wonder what she will think
amourAmiF.q14: Has she already met your parents?
amourAmiF.q14c: Yes, and they tease me about it
amourAmiF.q14d: Yes, and I really wanted them to like her
amourAmiF.q15: When she doesn't reply for a whole day…
amourAmiF.q15c: I check my phone more often
amourAmiF.q15d: It nags at me, I wonder what I did
